name: @va-team/nabu-gateway
description: VA.Team gateway bridge — LLM usage tracking via Cloudflare AI Gateway and credit-based gating

enabled.description: Whether LLM calls are allowed — toggled by NestJS when credits are exhausted/replenished

apiToken.description: Skill token sent as x-skill-token on usage/ingest. The backend route is unauthenticated today (@Public, org read from the body) — this token is sent ahead of a backend guard so the guard can ship without a lockstep release.
